description: This file defines the ProductCriteria class used for querying or filtering products in the application. It extends a base Criteria class and includes fields such as productName, categoryIds, availabilities, available status, productIds, manufacturerId, and attributeCriteria, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: ProductCriteria
classes.description: A class used for specifying search or filter criteria for products, including attributes like name, category, availability, manufacturer, and additional attribute criteria.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product as a search criterion.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the product name criterion for filtering products.

methods.name: getCategoryIds
methods.description: Returns list of category IDs used for filtering products.

methods.name: setCategoryIds
methods.description: Sets list of category IDs for product filtering.

methods.name: getAvailabilities
methods.description: Returns list of availability statuses used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setAvailabilities
methods.description: Sets list of availability statuses for filtering.

methods.name: getAttributeCriteria
methods.description: Returns list of attribute criteria for filtering based on product attributes.

methods.name: setAttributeCriteria
methods.description: Sets the list of attribute criteria.

methods.name: getProductIds
methods.description: Returns list of product IDs used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setProductIds
methods.description: Sets the list of product IDs.

methods.name: getManufacturerId
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer ID for filtering products.

methods.name: setManufacturerId
methods.description: Sets the manufacturer ID used for product filtering.
